ci: add continuous BenchmarkDotNet publishing workflow

Adds a new GitHub Actions workflow that runs the benchmarks in
test/OpenFeature.Benchmarks on push to main, daily on a schedule, and
via manual dispatch. Results are published to the gh-pages branch
using martincostello/benchmarkdotnet-results-publisher for tracking
performance over time via a GitHub Pages dashboard.

Also adds net8.0 to the benchmarks project's target frameworks so the
existing SimpleJob(RuntimeMoniker.Net80, baseline: true) benchmark job
can build and run in CI.

Closes #625

Signed-off-by: Berk Selvi <berkslv@gmail.com>

ci: harden benchmark workflow permissions and add concurrency control

- Set persist-credentials: false on checkout since only the publisher
  step needs write access, and it authenticates via its own repo-token
  input rather than relying on ambient git credentials.
- Add a concurrency group so overlapping push/schedule/dispatch runs
  cannot race when pushing results to gh-pages.
- Scope 'dotnet restore' to the benchmarks project explicitly instead
  of restoring the whole repository.

Addresses review feedback from CodeRabbit and Copilot on PR #791.

Signed-off-by: Berk Selvi <berkslv@gmail.com>
